pass_2.finding: Independently inspected all three published tables. Table 1 gives guide-vector cloning and validation oligos, including phospho bridge oligos; Table 2 gives gRNA targets and ordering strings; Table 3 maps samples to gRNAs and flow readouts. Springer MOESM267 duplicates Table 1. None gives Drop-seq bead RT-primer members or a prepared-bead barcode whitelist, so those must be assessed from linked Drop-seq sources.

missing_claims.evidence: False as a blanket statement: the inventor lab v3.1 protocol prints the family; its exact variable barcode members for CROP-seq remain unresolved. New lab source has one located check only.

conclusion: CROP-seq/Drop-seq source chain independently checked; inventor lab primer family recovered and page corrected. Exact prepared-bead members and original Drop-seq supplement remain blocked.
